io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.describe

Class CloudDescribeImportRequest

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.describe.BaseDescribeImportRequest
      • io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.describe.CloudDescribeImportRequest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class CloudDescribeImportRequest
extends BaseDescribeImportRequest
    Request for describing an import job on a Zilliz cloud instance.

    The job is identified by clusterId (or projectId and regionId for project database deployments) together with the jobId.
